title: Marker proof: render landmark spheres and compare with predicted pixels
summary: Right after solving a camera, render glowing spheres at ~5 landmark points (a ?marks=1 flag) and compare them with the solver's predicted pixels. One render caught the engine's opposite roll sign.

versions.note: seed harvest of the shot-match scenes (L3)

usage.example: if (new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('marks')) for (const p of LANDMARKS) S.scene.add(sphere(.12, 0x00ff40, p));   // see recipe.recon.prison-wall-dig-diorama

doc.when: After every camera solve, before building detail.
doc.avoid: Judging the camera by eye on a busy frame.
gotchas: Use unlit (toneMapped false) bright spheres so they read under any grade.

problem.symptom: Geometry built on a solved camera never lines up, and it is unclear whether the camera or the scene is wrong.
problem.cause: Sign/convention differences between solver and engine (roll, shift) or a wrong landmark.
problem.fix: Render markers at landmark points and compare positions to the predicted pixels; fix the convention, not the scene.
problem.detect: Markers off by more than ~10 px.
